# PDF Image Studio — Full Documentation for AI Agents

> Comprehensive documentation for PDF Image Studio, a client-side web application for PDF and image manipulation.

## System Capabilities
PDF Image Studio operates entirely in the browser using HTML5 Canvas, WebAssembly, and pdf-lib. All operations run locally inside the client's device memory.

## Available Routes & Operations

### PDF Tools
- `/pdf-organizer`: Visual drag-and-drop page reordering, page rotation (90, 180, 270 degrees), page deletion, duplication, and extraction.
- `/merge-pdf`: Reorder multiple PDF files and merge them into a single PDF document.
- `/split-pdf`: Split PDF documents by single pages, custom ranges (e.g. 1-3, 5, 8-10), or odd/even pages.
- `/compress-pdf`: Compress PDF documents with customizable quality presets (High, Medium, Low, Extreme).
- `/pdf-rotate`: Rotate all or selected pages in a PDF document.
- `/pdf-watermark`: Overlay custom text or image watermarks with opacity, angle, and position controls.
- `/pdf-page-numbers`: Add page numbers with customizable placement, font size, margin, and numbering format.
- `/pdf-metadata`: View and edit PDF Title, Author, Subject, Keywords, Creator, and Producer metadata tags.
- `/pdf-flatten`: Flatten interactive PDF form fields and annotations into static document content.
- `/pdf-redact-sanitize`: Remove hidden metadata, annotations, attachments, and visual text redaction.
- `/text-to-pdf`: Convert plain text or markdown formatted text into printable PDF documents.
- `/images-to-pdf`: Convert multiple image files (JPG, PNG, WebP) into a single PDF document with custom margins and page sizes.
- `/pdf-to-images`: Render PDF pages into high-resolution JPG or PNG images.

### Image Tools
- `/image-compressor`: Compress JPG, PNG, and WebP images with real-time target file size estimate.
- `/image-resizer`: Resize images by pixels, percentage, or specific aspect ratio constraints.
- `/image-converter`: Convert images between JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, BMP, and SVG formats.
- `/image-crop`: Crop images with preset aspect ratios (16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 9:16) or custom bounding boxes.
- `/image-rotate-flip`: Rotate images clockwise/counterclockwise and flip horizontally/vertically.
- `/image-strip-exif`: View, inspect, and strip sensitive EXIF metadata (GPS location, camera model, date) from photos.
- `/image-filter-adjust`: Apply brightness, contrast, saturation, blur, grayscale, and sepia filters.
- `/image-color-palette`: Extract color palettes (HEX, RGB, HSL) from uploaded images.

### Utility Pages
- `/all-tools`: Complete directory of all 18+ browser file utilities.
- `/batch-processor`: Process multiple files across tools in a single unified workspace.
- `/privacy`: Technical architecture whitepaper on client-side security and 100% in-memory execution.
- `/about`: Mission statement on replacing ad-heavy cloud file converters with local browser computing.
- `/terms`: Terms of service.
- `/blog`: Educational articles and tutorials on PDF and image workflows.

## Technical Specifications
- Base Domain: https://pdfimage.pages.dev/
- OpenGraph & Canonical Tags: Configured for rich social sharing and search engine indexing.
- PWA Compliant: Service worker enabled for offline usage.
